admin_native_assertions: Restricted SQL reader can read only monitoring views and cannot read/write raw audit, account or session tables.
Monitoring view hides arbitrary diagnostics/invalid fingerprints and retains allowed exception categories and paired archive hashes; fixture transaction rolled back.
Real role-mutation SQL rejects the last-admin demotion in an isolated temporary table containing only the synthetic admin.

assertions: Real Civic 2022 totals are 885 received complaints / 4 campaigns / 2 investigations; monthly values match an independent date count and STEERING matches 732 documents.
All-Civic comparison counts distinct official campaigns across years, while complaint counts partition by canonical vehicle identity.
Native aggregation includes UTC day boundaries, zero-fills February, keeps unknown flags/counts separate, counts overlapping component mentions, and excludes undated documents from the dated window.
A partial received-date window clips complaint counts/month links while official totals retain all stored dates.
An empty complaint collection still returns a valid catalogue scope with zero-valued charts and official counts.

account_deletion_native_assertions: Three independently signed-in target sessions are revoked after browser deletion; protected owner session remains valid.
limitations: Browser journeys were checked in the installed Chromium browser at desktop and 390px mobile sizes.
These checks do not establish compatibility with every browser or a complete accessibility audit.
Admin import initiation and broader final whole-application evaluation remain.
Controlled case projection/deletion faults leave the real database services running; they are enabled only for the case verifier.
The JSON discovery endpoint moved from / to /api; / now serves the browser interface.
